description: This file defines and manages a custom array data structure used within the larger C project. It includes functions for array initialization, memory management, data insertion, copying, comparison, and matching based on keys and values, supporting different data types such as string, integer, and array variants.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ data_unset * array_data_string_copy(const data_unset * s)
methods.description: Copies a string data element, including its key and value buffers.

methods.name: void array_data_string_free(data_unset * du)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a string data element's key and value buffers.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ data_string * array_data_string_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new data_string object with appropriate function pointers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ data_unset * array_data_integer_copy(const data_unset * s)
methods.description: Creates a copy of an integer data item, including its key.

methods.name: void array_data_integer_free(data_unset * du)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an integer data item.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ data_integer * array_data_integer_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new data_integer object with appropriate function pointers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ data_unset * array_data_array_copy(const data_unset * s)
methods.description: Copies an array data element, including its key and nested array contents.

methods.name: void array_data_array_free(data_unset * du)
methods.description: Frees memory for a data_array object, including its key and nested array.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ data_array * array_data_array_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new data_array object with function pointers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void array_extend(array * const a,uint32_t n)
methods.description: Resizes the array's internal data and sorted buffers to accommodate more elements.

methods.name: array * array_init(uint32_t n)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new array structure with optional initial size.

methods.name: void array_free_data(array * const a)
methods.description: Frees all data elements within the array and resets its fields.
